t: Jaipur ki Dravyavati nadi ke upar yeh road aapke areas ke daam badha sakti hai.
Ab JDA Dravyavati nadi ke upar 25 se 30 km ka 6 lane elevated road banane ja rahi hai.
Lekin iska kaaran jaante hain? Jaipur mein east se west cross karne wali kaafi saari sadkein hain.
Lekin north se south aane ke liye, Dravyavati nadi ke saath koi seedha raasta nahi hai.
Isliye Sikar Road se agar koi Sitapura ja raha ho, toh gaadiyan shehar ke beech mein ghoom ke jaati hain, aur har chauraahe par jam lagta hai.
Jab yeh nayi road ban jayegi, tab yeh nayi road in sabhi sadkon ko seedha seedha jodegi, aur shehar ke andar jam kam hoga.
Saath hi saath, jahan connectivity aati hai, wahan ke areas ki demand aur daam dono badhte hain.
Agar is road ke banne se aapko bhi relief milega, toh comment kijiye.
